reviews.title: Ads waste your time and give no rewards
reviews.text:
This game is absolutely terrible. I chose to watch an ad after walking so my reward would be multiplied by 6x. Instead, I was forced to sit through almost 5 minutes of ads. There was NO way to exit because the stupid X button completely disappeared, so I was stuck watching this disgusting, broken ad with no option to return to the main menu.

After wasting 5 minutes of my life, I had to restart the game. Guess what? The bonus was NOT counted at all. I got nothing. Zero reward. My time was completely wasted and not respected in any way.

This is beyond frustrating. If you are going to force people to watch ads, at least make sure your game actually gives the reward. Otherwise, it is just a scam.

1 star. And honestly, even that 1 star is too generous. This game does not deserve it.
